summary: Iteration 38 — Convert to Web App backend + frontend. Backend pytest suite: 24 passed, 4 skipped (xdist cross-worker state), 1 failure (login lockout does not trigger — real bug). All conversion, content-preservation, repeated-section collection copy, tenant visitor auth (register/login/me/forgot/reset), signup mode switching (open/approval/invite), invite flow, protected-page gate, submissions/CSV, admin panel API, content CRUD and analytics endpoints work. Frontend: convert-webapp-header-btn + convert-webapp-card visible on both a converted tenant (Northwind) and an unconverted legacy tenant (Aura); open-admin-panel-link visible after conversion. /site-admin/{token} renders site-admin-page with all 4 tabs (Submissions/Users/Content/Analytics), Analytics bars render, Users tab shows invite bar + suspend/promote buttons, Content tab lists all collections. Live site /p/{token} shows themed data-testid=member-gate on a protected /about page with Create-account and Forgot-password links; member-signout appears after member login. Content preservation VERIFIED on a fresh Aura Wellness conversion — every block prop matches pre-conversion snapshot; only added keys are props.collection / props.dynamic. Cross-tenant token isolation verified: tenant JWT → 401 on /api/apps and 401 on another tenant's /auth/me.

critical.issue: Brute-force lockout (5 fails → 429) never triggers. Confirmed with curl (7 consecutive wrong-password attempts return 401, never 429). Root cause: identifier keys off request.client.host, which behind the Kubernetes ingress is the pod IP (or is even sticky per replica). Attempts distributed across replicas (or absent Client info) prevent count from ever reaching 5. Should key off X-Forwarded-For / X-Real-IP.

minor.issue: Returns pages array with keys page_id/name/slug/protected only. Protected flag is None (not false) for pages never touched — cosmetic but forces null-checks on client.

For tenants with only the four default pages (/, /about, /services, /contact) protected_pages is [] and admin_panel_url returned in body — that's expected, but summary.protected_pages = [] may look empty to end-users. Consider surfacing 'members-only pages: 0 (toggle any page after conversion)'.

action_items: Fix brute-force lockout on POST /api/site/{token}/auth/login by keying rate-limit identifier off X-Forwarded-For (or app_id+email only) so a distributed pod set actually counts to 5. Currently the review requirement 'wrong password 401, 5 failures then 429 lockout' is NOT met.
(Optional) initialise pages.protected = false at conversion time so consumers don't see mixed null/true/false.
critical_code_review_comments: site_app.py line 413-419: rate-limit identifier uses request.client.host which behind K8s ingress is the pod IP; multi-replica deployments will not observe cumulative count. Switch to request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for','').split(',')[0].strip() or drop IP from the key entirely (app_id+email is enough).
site_app.py convert() line 274: `token = doc.get('preview_token') or _uid('pv').replace('pv_', 'pv_')` — the .replace is a no-op leftover; harmless but delete it.

site_app.py current_site_user() ignores audience mismatch by returning None (correct) but relies on jwt.decode with audience=SITE_AUD to reject agency tokens — verified working (agency JWT → 401 on tenant /auth/me).

PublicPreview.jsx line 45: `gated` becomes false while `member.loading` is true, so protected page blocks briefly flash before the gate mounts. Suggest inverting to `gated = converted && page.protected && !member.user` and showing a skeleton while loading.

site_app.py admin_user_patch() line 588: self-demotion check compares site_user_id, but when an agency owner acts through the panel me.site_user_id is their agency user_id (see require_panel line 180) — matches, so demotion via panel works, but if the same agency user_id happens to equal a tenant site_user_id we could falsely block. Very unlikely (different prefixes) but worth an explicit source check.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the flows exercised (convert buttons on converted + legacy tenants, admin panel tabs, member gate, member sign-in)

rca of the issue: Login lockout: site_app.site_login builds identifier=f'{request.client.host}:{app_id}:{email}'. In this K8s ingress, request.client.host varies per proxy hop / replica, so the counter never accumulates to 5 in a single row. Fix: use X-Forwarded-For header (or drop the host component entirely — app_id+email is a sufficient key for tenant login abuse protection).
